findings.title: data_path.ddr_dq_o is 32 bits; the spec declares 16
findings.detail: data_path_mapping.ddr_channel_width_bits = 16, so data_path.ddr_dq_o must be 16 bits wide; the design makes it 32. The DDR data bus is the channel width. pack_mode 'pack_32_to_16' means each 32-bit host word is driven as two 16-bit beats, so the DQ ports are 16 bits, not 32.
